source.eoh_timestamp_policy: date/hour plus 1h availability; spot open then is index proxy
source.historical_rate: not needed for mark-IV regression; no private data

surface_model.logk_formula: ln(K/F), F=S*exp(r*T); fit uses spot proxy and r=0
surface_model.note: Bounded power-law SSVI shape fitted to 2023 mark-IV ratios, not to strategy profitability; constraints and finite-grid checks do not establish real-world market adequacy.

execution.grid_note: Observed price grid, not proof of historical/current exchange tick rule.

limitations: 147 days in one 2023 regime, 12 whole dates and other hours missing; not 2026 IV/liquidity coverage
Mark IV is exchange model mark and best_buy_iv is entirely absent; regression does not prove sellable IV
Spot open is a proxy for option index; one-hour snapshots cannot reveal intra-hour sequence or latency
A Gaussian AR1 residual alone may understate IV tail shocks; empirical innovation bootstrap and IV-stress sensitivity required
Fitted shape is not automatically butterfly/calendar-arbitrage free; reject/correct option-price monotonicity/convexity violations in simulator
No side coefficient so equal K/T receives same sigma, preserving model put-call parity; does not prove dynamic market calibration
Quote rows weight different strike/tenor listings; regression gives each hour equal total weight but selection remains
No quoted depth at zero/no-bid states means inability to close should be explicitly simulated, not treated as fair-value fill
Physical BTC model and this market-pricing IV model are separate; IV richness must not be optimized for positive strategy results
No perpetual-funding, historical borrowing, true queue priority, liquidations, account netting or multi-second execution data
